hooks.command:
echo `# <#` >/dev/null; exec "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/codex-asked"
#> > $null; $PSModuleAutoLoadingPreference = 'None'; $h = "$env:USERPROFILE\.harness\bin\harness.exe"; if (-not [IO.File]::Exists($h)) { $h = $null; foreach ($d in $env:PATH -split ';') { if ($d -match '^([a-z]:\\|\\\\)' -and [IO.File]::Exists("$d\harness.exe")) { $h = "$d\harness.exe"; break } } }; if ($h) { & $h device codex asked *> $null }; exit 0

echo `# <#` >/dev/null; exec "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/codex-asked"
#> > $null; $PSModuleAutoLoadingPreference = 'None'; $h = "$env:USERPROFILE\.harness\bin\harness.exe"; if (-not [IO.File]::Exists($h)) { $h = $null; foreach ($d in $env:PATH -split ';') { if ($d -match '^([a-z]:\\|\\\\)' -and [IO.File]::Exists("$d\harness.exe")) { $h = "$d\harness.exe"; break } } }; if ($h) { & $h device codex asked *> $null }; exit 0

echo `# <#` >/dev/null; exec "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/codex-start"
#> > $null; $PSModuleAutoLoadingPreference = 'None'; $h = "$env:USERPROFILE\.harness\bin\harness.exe"; if (-not [IO.File]::Exists($h)) { $h = $null; foreach ($d in $env:PATH -split ';') { if ($d -match '^([a-z]:\\|\\\\)' -and [IO.File]::Exists("$d\harness.exe")) { $h = "$d\harness.exe"; break } } }; if ($h) { $o = & $h device codex start 2> $null; if ("$o".StartsWith('{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":')) { [Console]::Out.Write("$o") } }; exit 0

echo `# <#` >/dev/null; exec "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/codex-stop"
#> > $null; $PSModuleAutoLoadingPreference = 'None'; $h = "$env:USERPROFILE\.harness\bin\harness.exe"; if (-not [IO.File]::Exists($h)) { $h = $null; foreach ($d in $env:PATH -split ';') { if ($d -match '^([a-z]:\\|\\\\)' -and [IO.File]::Exists("$d\harness.exe")) { $h = "$d\harness.exe"; break } } }; if ($h) { $o = & $h device codex stop 2> $null; if ("$o".StartsWith('{"decision":"block","reason":')) { [Console]::Out.Write("$o") } }; exit 0
